Contract Generator.contract:
Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		selectedCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o: BankCard|o.CardID = cardid),
		cardExists: Boolean = if BankCard.allInstance()->includes(selectedCard) 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		BankCard.allInstance()->isUnique(o: BankCard|o.CardID)
	postcondition:
		self.CardIDValidated = cardExists and
		if cardExists 
		then self.InputCard = selectedCard 
		else self.InputCard = null 
		endif  and
		result = self.CardIDValidated
}
